newsitem.title: USA: GreenStone okays purchase by La.-Pacific.
newsitem.headline: GreenStone okays purchase by La.-Pacific.

text.p: GreenStone Industries Inc said on Monday that it signed a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by Louisiana-Pacific Corp.

GreenStone public shareholders would receive $5.25 per share in cash, the company said. Management and certain affiliated shareholders would receive restricted Louisiana-Pacific securities of equivalent value, it said.
The merger agreement has been approved by the boards of both companies, GreenStone said.
GreenStone said it also expected to hold a shareholder meeting in December to vote on the proposed merger. The deal was subject to GreenStone shareholder approval.

"We expect that the combination of the respective strengths of our companies will contribute to significantly increasing the market for our superior cellulose insulation products," said Eric Oganesoff, GreenStone chairman and chief executive officer.
GreenStone Industries manufactures cellulose insulation and specialty fibers from recycled paper.

Under the agreement, Lousiana-Pacific has also agreed to reduce the exercise price of GreenStone's publicly traded stock purchase warrants to $4.95, for a period of 60 days following the closing of the merger. GreenStone said it would have to pay a break-up fee of up to $500,000 if the transaction was terminated under specified circumstances.
